name: Nichinan Kaigan Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of the Nichinan coast of southern Miyazaki: the Udo shrine's sea-cave torii, the Aoshima island and its wave-cut 'washing board' rocks, and the Obi castle town.
notes: Managed by Miyazaki/Kagoshima. The coastal road from Miyazaki to Aoshima and Udo is the classic drive.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)

ja.name: 日南海岸国定公園
ja.description: 宮崎南部の日南海岸の国定公園。鵜戸神宮の海食洞の鳥居、青島の「洗濯板」岩、飫肥の城下町が特徴。
ja.notes: 宮崎・鹿児島両県が管理。宮崎から青島・鵜戸へ続く海岸道路が定番ドライブコース。
